name: sclk-many
comment: A TIME section with many pieces, for the search in lite_host2et. The clock is SYNTHETIC (test/fixtures/synthetic-tt-steady.tsc: one rate, running on TT); held to a tenth of a microsecond over 240 days it needs about two hundred pieces. The explicit entries put other time bases below and above the clock's, and are listed out of order on purpose: the slicer writes TIME sorted by base, then start. The Sun is here only because a blob needs an ephemeris segment.
